name: HStudio ESP32-S3 Wi-Fi Setup Firmware v2

hardware.board: HStudio ESP32-S3 hardware with ES8311 audio and ST7789 240x240 SPI display

display.note: 128x64 logical canvas scaled 1.875x to 240x120, vertically centered

features: Same application logic as ESP32-C3 firmware v2
LAN and remote Hermes endpoint discovery
ST7789 status UI (128x64 logical canvas on 240x240 display)
Selectable push-to-talk and local-VAD listening modes
Selectable Ekko and Hermes agent runtimes with isolated sessions
Sample-synchronized GB2312 subtitles during speech playback
Configurable connected standby with a three-minute default
AC-powered: battery telemetry reported as unknown
